verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Cloudflare Registrar accepting natural-language commands, such as a built-in assistant or a documented agent workflow for registering or managing domains. The Registrar API, OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are developer building blocks. The Cloudflare-wide MCP server probe does not show any registrar coverage or natural-language operation of this product, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
